|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of Levitation Attack (V), the earliest surviving text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-levitationattack-pre.gif]], slip number 65E), which prints this text; the same image is in the V-kit of 9 December 2009. The first printing of September 2009 is lost; see the history below. The current text is [[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4): the Master List of 27 April 2013.
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-levitationattack-pre.gif]], slip number 65E, errata mark E) prints: “▼ (or retrieve) a device (for free). [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel Sabotage targeting a device. OR During a battle, place your weapon or device present in Used Pile to add 2 to your total power (3 if Vader present).” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-2009">Lee Edwards' V-kit, [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips swccgvkit-legacy <code>public/images/vslips</code>] (commit 81e0048, migrated from svn on 28 May 2010; the <code>.svn/entries</code> files record svn r1 committed 2009-12-09T05:41:52Z for these slips). The file <code>virtual6-dark/levitationattack.png</code> is the same image as the Players Committee card image (same words, slip number and errata mark), compared by eye on 11 November 2026.</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list stamps the card “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026, as for the H1 cards, e.g. [[Away Put Your Weapon (V)]]). It is the earliest surviving text of the card. The PC website's image folder carries the same file with the server date 25 February 2013, a later bulk upload of the unchanged image. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 2 set mark) and prints the number “65E” bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “62E”).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “▼ (or retrieve) a device (for free). [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel Sabotage targeting a device. OR During battle, place your weapon or device present in Used Pile to add 2 to your total power (3 if Vader present).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 62E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-62E-Levitation_Attack.png]]) prints slip number “62E” bottom right. '''What changed:''' compared with PC-E1 (the PC card image), “During a battle” becomes “During battle”.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata 3)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “During a battle” for “During battle” (it writes ▼ out as “Deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and the Immune to Sense icon as “(Immune to Sense.)”, which is notation only, and adds the credit line “(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”): “Deploy (or retrieve) a device (for free) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel Sabotage targeting a device. OR During a battle, place your weapon or device present in Used Pile to add 2 to your total power (3 if Vader present). (Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”<ref name="cl-1220_62-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Levitation Attack (V) (Errata 4)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 37), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=37, page 37. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=37 Internet Archive]</ref>: “▼ (or retrieve) a device (for free). [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel Sabotage targeting a device. OR During battle, place your weapon or device present in Used Pile to add 2 to your total power (3 if Vader present).” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 (PC-E2) again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E3) had gone back to the PC-E1 wording. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1220-62-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it prints the errata mark “E” bottom right.
